title: felix-canary crash-loop configuration (scripts/canary/crash_loop_config.json)

threshold.description: Restart rise since the previous canary tick that pages (default 3).

quiet_ticks_to_clear.description: K: consecutive no-rise ticks before a cleared entry (FR-008). Default 2.

ignore.description: Units/containers that never raise a crash-loop alert (FR-002). Exact match on UnitKey; unique; reason required.

max_alerts_per_tick.description: Individual crash-loop notifications per tick; all remaining events fold into one bounded aggregate alert (research R-15). Default 3.

read_budget_seconds.description: Monotonic deadline for reading all three scopes (research R-15). Default 6.

consecutive_rise_ticks.description: Consecutive ticks with any rise that also page (default 2).

reremind_ticks.description: Ticks after the last page before a re-remind may fire on fresh evidence (default 24 = 6 h at 15 min).

description: Ruling 2026-11-24 (Kent): tick counting. Page on a rise >= threshold since the previous tick, or a rise >= 1 on consecutive_rise_ticks consecutive ticks. window_seconds is retired (no time in the decision).
